purpose: Test an outcome-blind shortest-remaining-workflow-first ready-frontier order combined with four frozen placement experts on a fresh paired three-load cohort.

fresh_development_cohort.pre_registration_check: No file under tmp contained E220 before this plan was written.

source.design_basis: The fixed-window objective rewards completed workflows, while existing operational ordering is request-ID-primary. SRPT is the classical outcome-blind policy for reducing completion time and increasing completed-job count. Ready-frontier restriction avoids spending placements on blocked descendants. Frozen Hiku/OCS/Orion scores cover warm reuse, current demand, queue balance, resource headroom, and DAG locality without reading outcomes.

mechanism.workflow_priority: For every active request, sum outcome-blind normalized remaining CPU work, normalized cold-start work, and normalized transfer work over unfinished functions. Sort the parent-complete ready frontier by ascending request remaining work, then descending within-request critical-path rank, then stable request/function IDs.
mechanism.placement: Use one preregistered frozen expert on the common feasible-node set. The expert only breaks paper-utility indifference and seeds the canonical Nash state; reference players/objective remain unchanged.

candidates.definition: SRPT ready-frontier order plus frozen pending-plus-running load-faithful Hiku placement.
SRPT ready-frontier order plus frozen OCS current-demand placement.
SRPT ready-frontier order plus frozen pending-plus-running Orion placement.
SRPT ready-frontier order plus equal-vote ordinal Borda over frozen load-faithful Hiku and OCS placement ranks.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan; implement and test exactly the four declared profiles; freeze one source/binary/runtime commit; create E220-E224 tapes; bind the identical tapes to all thirteen methods; build all sixty references; run all 195 processes without metrics; require exact QC and joint pairing; reveal all loads and candidates together.

selection.per_load_winner_gate: For a load, one candidate must have a strictly larger five-seed arithmetic mean than each of the other twelve paired methods for throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-completion-as-zero QPR simultaneously.
selection.failure_action: Retain the entire failed cohort and do not tune on E220-E224.
